# APIVALE Technical Documentation & LLM Gateway

> APIVALE provides enterprise-grade, low-latency API routing gateways connecting global developers to frontier foundation models (DeepSeek V4, Qwen 3.7 Max, GLM-5.3, MiniMax H3, Kimi K3) via OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible protocols with zero KYC, instant PayPal checkout, and 0% foreign transaction fees.

## Core Model & Persistent Agent Guides
- [OpenAI Dots API & Pricing vs Meta Muse](https://apivel.com/blog/openai-dots-api-pricing-vs-muse/): Comprehensive evaluation of OpenAI Dots API availability, Pro pricing tiers ($100/mo), background token burn, sandbox timeouts, and self-hosted OpenDots setup via APIVALE.
- [Meta Muse AI API Setup & Pricing](https://apivel.com/blog/meta-muse-ai-api-setup/): Complete guide to Meta Model API key generation, Muse Spark 1.1 token pricing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration.
- [GPT-6 Astra API Pricing Guide](https://apivel.com/blog/gpt-6-astra-api-pricing-guide/): Technical benchmarks, token pricing breakdown, and proxy failover architectures for OpenAI's frontier agentic model.
- [OpenRouter Alternatives with PayPal Billing](https://apivel.com/blog/openrouter-alternatives/): In-depth comparison of multi-provider AI gateways, card decline fixes, and PayPal instant checkout.
- [DeepSeek V4 Flash API Guide](https://apivel.com/blog/deepseek-v4-flash-api-guide/): High-throughput reasoning model endpoints, token cost optimization, and streaming connection stabilization.
- [How to Connect Qwen 3.8 to Claude Code CLI](https://apivel.com/blog/how-to-connect-qwen-3-8-to-claude-code-cli/): Step-by-step CLI setup, custom base URL configuration, and context window tuning.
